summary_en: AS ONE will cancel 2,600,000 treasury shares (3.47% of issued shares) on October 30, 2026, reducing treasury holdings to 4.96% of issued shares in line with its policy targeting 5% maximum treasury share holding.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
AS ONE Corporation resolved at its Board of Directors meeting on October 8, 2026, to cancel 2,600,000 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represents 3.47% of issued shares prior to cancellation and includes 2,500,004 shares acquired through a public tender offer resolved on August 7, 2026.

The company maintains a policy of holding treasury shares at approximately 5% of total issued shares. This cancellation reduces treasury holdings exceeding that target, bringing treasury shares to 4.96% of issued shares following the cancellation scheduled for October 30, 2026. After the cancellation, issued shares will total 72,412,540 and treasury shares will number 3,590,882.
